lang.label: Language
accessKey.title: Access key
accessKey.lead: This hub is protected by an access key. Enter it to use the panel: it stays saved in this browser, for this hub only.
accessKey.label: Key
accessKey.hint: It is the REKORD_ACCESS_KEY value the hub was started with.
accessKey.errFormat: The key has at least {{min}} characters: letters, digits and . _ ~ -
accessKey.errInvalid: Wrong key. Check it and try again.
accessKey.errStoredInvalid: The saved key no longer works: it may have been changed on the hub. Enter the new one.
accessKey.errLocked: Wrong key. After too many wrong attempts, every wrong key is refused for about a minute: the right key still works.
accessKey.errLockedFor: Wrong key. After too many wrong attempts, every wrong key is refused for {{seconds}} s: the right key still works.
accessKey.errUnreachable: Can't reach the hub: check that it is running and that the network works.
accessKey.errNotHub: Unexpected answer: this is not a RE-KORD hub.

lede.jobs: Scans, thumbnails and restores in progress.
lede.diagnostics: Versions, disk space, external programs and recent errors.

library.root.title: Music folder
library.scan.hint: An update re-reads only new or changed files and removes from the catalog the ones gone from disk; if too many vanish at once (for example a disk that isn't mounted) it keeps them and asks you to confirm. A full rebuild re-reads every file and removes everything it can't find: use it after a large tag edit.
library.layout.title: Library structure
library.layout.deepScan: Treat each subfolder as a separate album (CD1, CD2, Bonus…)
library.layout.hint: With this off, tracks in subfolders stay in the same album as the parent folder. Tracks without an artist or album go under “{{artist}}” and “{{album}}”.
library.watch.title: Automatic updates
library.watch.toggle: Watch the folder and update the library on its own
library.maint.title: Maintenance
library.maint.thumbsHint: Thumbnails speed up the client's grids.
library.embedded.title: Embedded metadata
library.embedded.hint: Title, artist, album, track and disc numbers, date, genres, BPM, lyrics and cover stored in the files (FLAC, MP3, M4A, OGG, Opus, WAV, AIFF, WMA, WebM) fill empty fields on the first scan of a file and whenever the file changes. Edits made by hand in Studio are never overwritten. Embedded covers are used only for albums without an image in their folder and are kept in the hub's data: the music folder is not touched.
library.embedded.pending: Still to read: {{tracks}}, {{albums}} without a cover.
library.embedded.overrideConfirm: Re-read embedded metadata and also replace values typed by hand in Studio? This can't be undone.
library.embedded.downloadsToggle: Embed tags and cover in downloaded files
library.embedded.downloadsHint: Tracks downloaded from Studio get title, artist, album, album artist, track number, date and genre (when known) and the cover, cropped to a square. An album download also saves cover.jpg in its folder when it has no cover yet. Files that were already in the folder are not touched.
library.maint.rereadOverride: Re-read and replace Studio values too
library.maint.rereadHint: Re-reading refreshes the values taken from the file tags and the embedded covers, in the background (see Jobs). Studio values stay.
legacy.hint: The import reads the .kord folder inside the music folder and merges it with the hub's data, account by account: it adds missing favorites, playlists, moods, blocked tracks and albums, play counts and accounts, and only fills empty settings. It never overwrites anything you created or changed in this version, and accounts already imported from the same files are left alone, so it is safe to run again.
scan.report.title: Last scan from this panel ({{mode}}, {{when}})
scan.prune.title: Missing tracks kept in the library
scan.prune.bodyCount: The last scan could not find {{count}} tracks on disk. That is too many to vanish at once: the files look missing only for now, for example an external or network disk that isn't mounted, or a folder that was moved. To be safe, nothing was removed from the catalog.
scan.prune.body: The last scan could not find many tracks on disk. The files look missing only for now, for example an external or network disk that isn't mounted, or a folder that was moved. To be safe, nothing was removed from the catalog.
scan.prune.advice: Check that the disk is connected and run the update again. If the files really were deleted, confirm the removal with a full rebuild.
scan.confirmFull:
A full rebuild re-reads every file and removes from the catalog every track it cannot find on disk. Favorites and playlist entries are kept waiting and reconnect if the files come back.

Make sure all disks are connected. Continue?
scan.unreadable.title: Folders that could not be read: {{count}}
scan.unreadable.body: These folders (relative to the music folder) could not be opened, usually because of permissions or a disconnected network disk. Their tracks were left as they were.
scan.parked.title: Waiting for files
scan.parked.body: {{favorites}} and {{playlistTracks}} are waiting for their file to come back. They reconnect on their own at the next scan that finds it; after a year they are forgotten.
jobs.title: Operations
diag.jsMissing: YouTube requires a JavaScript engine for yt-dlp: none found. Use a RE-KORD server package (it includes QuickJS) or install Deno or Node.js 22+.
diag.errors.title: Recent errors
activity.title: Activity log
backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: The backup contains settings, accounts, favorites, playlists and library metadata. Audio files are not included: they stay in the music folder.
backup.secret.title: The ZIP file contains credentials
backup.secret.body: It also holds the Discogs token and the YouTube cookies: anyone with the file can use them as you. Keep it somewhere private and don't share it.
backup.restoreConfirm: Restore “{{name}}”? The hub's settings, accounts and personal data will be replaced with the ones in the backup.
backup.machineOnly: Backup and restore run from the hub's computer with the Default account (or with remote access enabled under Network).
backup.legacy.title: Import from legacy RE-KORD
backup.legacy.hint: Backups from the React version (v2) are recognised automatically: accounts, favorites, playlists and metadata are imported, then the library is re-indexed. The music folder must already exist on disk.
backup.legacy.importHint: Brings over what you had in the previous RE-KORD (React/Electron): favorites, playlists, moods, tracks and albums blocked from shuffle, play counts and recent tracks, settings, Plectr records, library selections and theme backgrounds. It runs by itself after the first scan; use the button to run it again or to see what it would add.
backup.legacy.notFound: No legacy data: the music folder has no .kord folder.
backup.legacy.pending: Legacy data found, not imported yet: it is imported after the next library scan, or now with the button.
backup.legacy.optedOut: Legacy data found. The automatic import is turned off (REKORD_SKIP_LEGACY_IMPORT): use the button.
backup.legacy.resultPreview: Preview ({{when}}): what an import would add, nothing was changed
backup.legacy.reason.not_registered: account deleted in the legacy app
backup.legacy.reason.already_imported: files unchanged since the last import
backup.legacy.unmatchedMore: …and {{n}} more. They are kept and link up when the files are indexed.
backup.legacy.notRegistered.one: {{n}} folder of an account deleted in the legacy app was skipped.
backup.legacy.notRegistered.other: {{n}} folders of accounts deleted in the legacy app were skipped.
backup.legacy.accountsAdded.one: {{n}} account created with its legacy name.
backup.legacy.accountsAdded.other: {{n}} accounts created with their legacy name.
backup.legacy.metadataError: The legacy library database could not be read ({{error}}); personal data was imported anyway.
accounts.title: Local accounts
accounts.deleteConfirm: Delete the account “{{name}}”? This account's favorites, playlists and statistics will be lost.
accounts.new.title: New account
accounts.new.name: Name
accounts.new.hint: Each account has its own favorites, playlists, statistics and theme. The library on disk is shared.
integrations.yt.lockedByEnv: The cookies come from an environment variable: change them on the system.
integrations.yt.hint: Cookies are needed for age-restricted or members-only content. Export them from your browser in Netscape format.
integrations.discogs.lockedByEnv: The token comes from an environment variable: change it on the system.
integrations.discogs.hint: With the token set, the Studio can look up editions, labels and catalog numbers on Discogs.
integrations.machineOnly: Credentials are changed from the hub's computer with the Default account.
network.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the address and copy it by hand.
network.qrIncludeKey: Include the access key in the QR
network.qrIncludeKeyWarn: Anyone who sees or photographs this QR also gets the key. Show it only to whoever needs to connect, and hide it right after.
network.lan.title: Local network access
network.lan.none: No local network address found: check that the computer is connected to a network.
network.lan.hint: From a phone or another computer, open the local network address: the web client and the API answer on the same port.
network.lan.hintMany: From a phone or another computer, open the first address; if it doesn't answer, try the others (the computer is on several networks, for example Wi-Fi and cable or a VPN). The web client and the API answer on the same port.
network.lan.qrCaption: Scan with the RE-KORD app to connect your phone
network.accessKey.stored: The access key is saved in this browser.
network.hubKey.title: Access key
network.hubKey.hint: With a key, every device must present it to use the hub (API and audio). Use it when the hub is reachable from outside your home: tunnel or reverse proxy, always over HTTPS. It does not replace accounts, which stay profiles without passwords.
network.hubKey.source.off: no key: the hub is open to anyone who reaches it
network.hubKey.envNote: The key comes from the REKORD_ACCESS_KEY environment variable: change or remove it there, then restart the hub.
network.hubKey.cannotManage: Setting or removing the key is a machine operation: it needs the Default account on the hub computer, or machine operations allowed remotely.
network.hubKey.rules: 32 to 256 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -, at least 10 different characters, no repeated block. "Generate" makes a random one: copy it before saving, the hub keeps only its digest.
network.hubKey.afterSet: This browser already has the key. Other devices will ask for it on their next request: pass it with the QR above ("include the key") or by hand.
network.hubKey.removeConfirm: Remove the access key? The hub will be open again to anyone who reaches it, through the tunnel too.
network.hubKey.malformed: The key needs 32 to 256 characters from letters, digits and . _ ~ -
errors.code.access_key_from_env: The key is set by REKORD_ACCESS_KEY: change it there.
errors.code.access_key_weak: Key refused: too short, with characters that are not allowed, or too weak (few different characters or a repeated block).
network.remote.title: Access from outside
network.remote.qrCaption: Scan from outside to connect your phone
network.remote.noCloudflared: Install cloudflared to open a temporary tunnel, or set REKORD_PUBLIC_URL if you already have your own address.
network.machine.title: Machine operations
network.machine.hint: Music folder, scans, credentials, backups, restores and the tunnel are controlled from here. They normally need the Default account and this computer; the tunnel does not count as local.
network.machine.allowRemote: Also allow these operations remotely (local network and tunnel)
network.machine.remoteNote: You are using the panel remotely: this switch can only be changed from the hub's computer.
msg.scanAlreadyRunning: A scan is already running: following its progress…
msg.scanStillRunning: The scan is taking a while: the hub keeps going, following its progress…
msg.watchOn: Folder watching on: the library updates on its own.
msg.embeddedSaved: Setting saved: the library is being re-read in the background.
msg.backupDownloaded: Backup downloaded. Keep it somewhere private.
msg.cloudflareLogin: Finish logging in to Cloudflare in the window that opened.
msg.remoteAdminOn: Machine operations are now allowed remotely too.
msg.remoteAdminOff: Machine operations are limited to this computer.
errors.network: Can't reach the hub: check that it is running and that the network works.
errors.timeout: The hub did not answer within {{seconds}} seconds. Try again shortly.
errors.unreachableStatus: Can't reach the hub (HTTP {{status}}): it may be off or restarting.
errors.notAvailable: This feature is not available on this hub: update the hub to the latest version.
errors.forbiddenDefault: Only the Default account can do this.
errors.forbiddenRemote: This can only be done from the hub's computer. To do it from here, enable remote admin under Network › Machine operations, on the hub's computer.
errors.scanBusy: A scan is already running: wait for it to finish.
errors.musicRootMissing: The music folder does not exist or can't be reached: check that the disk is connected.
errors.legacyDataNotFound: No legacy RE-KORD data: the music folder has no .kord folder.
errors.accountNotFound: Account not found: it may have been deleted.
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large for the hub.

hub.activity.restore.remoteAdminIgnored: The backup's remote machine-operations setting was ignored (stays off)

lede.podcasts: News bulletins, podcasts and live radio in the player. Optional module, off by default.
podcasts.module.title: Module
podcasts.module.hint: When off, the module costs nothing: no requests, no timers, no entries in the app. When on, the hub fetches a source only when someone opens the card or the section, and keeps only the latest episodes' titles.
podcasts.ttl.label: Cache lifetime (minutes)
podcasts.ttl.hint: How long a fetched source stays valid before the next opening fetches it again. The app's Refresh button bypasses the cache.
podcasts.add.title: Add a source
podcasts.add.name: Name (optional)
podcasts.add.namePlaceholder: Taken from the feed when empty
podcasts.add.liveOk: Live stream: it shows up as a single LIVE item.
podcasts.add.hint: Works with podcast RSS/Atom feeds, pages that point to a feed, play.rtl.it pages (e.g. Giornale Orario), pages yt-dlp can read and MP3/AAC radio streams, also from .m3u/.pls playlists. HLS streams (.m3u8) are not supported.
podcasts.add.noYtdlp: yt-dlp is disabled on this hub: pages without a feed cannot be added.
podcasts.list.title: Sources
podcasts.list.namePlaceholder: Empty: back to the feed's title
podcasts.msg.enabled: Podcasts & news turned on: the app shows it at its next refresh.
errors.code.podcasts_disabled: The Podcasts & news module is turned off.
errors.code.podcast_invalid_url: Invalid address: an http or https link is needed.
errors.code.url_not_allowed: Address not allowed: it points to the local network or a private address.
errors.code.podcast_fetch_timeout: The source did not answer in time.
errors.code.podcast_fetch_failed: The hub could not reach the source.
errors.code.podcast_http_error: The source answered with an error (missing page or access denied).
errors.code.podcast_too_large: The source's answer is too large.
errors.code.podcast_parse_failed: The source's feed could not be read.
errors.code.podcast_unsupported_url: Unsupported address: no RSS/Atom feed, playlist, stream or page yt-dlp can read.
errors.code.podcast_hls_unsupported: HLS streams (.m3u8) are not supported: look for an MP3 or AAC address of the same station.
errors.code.podcast_no_episodes: Feed found, but it has no audio episodes.
errors.code.podcast_resolve_failed: Could not get the episode's audio.
errors.code.podcast_proxy_busy: Too many streams at once: try again shortly.
errors.code.ytdlp_disabled: yt-dlp is disabled on this hub (ENABLE_YTDLP=0).
errors.code.ytdlp_not_found: yt-dlp was not found on the hub.
errors.code.ytdlp_timeout: yt-dlp did not answer in time.
errors.code.ytdlp_failed: yt-dlp could not read the page.
power.title: Power
power.hint: Keeps the hub's computer from going to sleep, so phones, the local network and remote access can still reach it. Only system sleep is blocked: the screen can still turn off and lock.
power.mode.label: Prevent sleep
power.mode.hint.off: The computer follows its own power settings: the hub does nothing.
power.mode.hint.always: The computer does not go to sleep while the hub is running.
power.mode.hint.whenActive: The computer stays awake while the hub is working (playback, scans, downloads, remote access through the tunnel) and for a few minutes after the last activity.
power.lockedByEnv: The mode is set at start-up by --prevent-sleep or REKORD_PREVENT_SLEEP: change it in the service configuration.
power.grace.label: Minutes after the last activity
power.grace.hint: {{min}} to {{max}} minutes. Covers the gaps between tracks.
power.lid.label: Stay awake with the lid closed (laptops)
power.lid.hint: Linux only. Careful: a closed laptop in a bag or backpack can get very hot. The system (polkit) may refuse this lock.
power.status.off: The computer can go to sleep.
power.status.idle: The computer can go to sleep: nothing is running.
power.unsupported: On this system the hub cannot prevent sleep (Linux needs systemd; it does not work inside Docker).
power.msg.off: The computer can go to sleep again.
power.msg.always: The computer will not sleep while the hub is running.
power.msg.whenActive: The computer will stay awake while the hub is in use.
errors.code.power_unsupported: This system does not let the hub block sleep.
errors.code.power_refused: The system refused the lock (polkit permissions): see the guide for system services.
errors.code.power_locked_by_env: The mode is set by --prevent-sleep / REKORD_PREVENT_SLEEP.
errors.code.invalid_prevent_sleep: Invalid mode: use Never, Always or Only when in use.
errors.code.settings_save_failed: Settings not saved: settings.json can't be written.
integrations.yt.cookiesNoYoutube: The file holds no YouTube or Google cookies: export them while on youtube.com.
integrations.yt.howTo: Export them from a private window after signing in to YouTube, then close it: if it stays open, YouTube rotates them and the exported ones stop working.
errors.code.cookies_invalid: The file is not a Netscape-format cookies.txt.
errors.code.cookies_json: The file is JSON: export the cookies in Netscape format (cookies.txt).
errors.code.cookies_locked_by_env: The cookies come from an environment variable: change them on the system.
errors.code.access_key_required: This hub requires an access key.
errors.code.access_key_rate_limited: Wrong key, and too many wrong attempts for now. The right key still works.
errors.accessKeyLockedFor: Wrong key: every wrong key is refused for {{seconds}} s. The right key still works.
